items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: 'Show Girl,' a show called 'Show Girl', with Ruby Keeler.

ctx.x: Do you think the Cotton Club shows were better than the Ziegfeld shows.

Oh, no. They're two different shows. Because Ziegfeld, he glamorized the American woman. We done a Ziegfeld show, next to the last show. 'Show Girl,' a show called 'Show Girl', with Ruby Keeler. Next to the last show he ever done, we were still at the Cotton Club and did that show. We were doubling that's right. The show 'Lives of an American in Paris', from the Ziegfeld shows, 'Liza', that all the bands played, was from that show. we played it. That's right. We were the first one of the (Unintelligible) to play…

12 or 13 weeks, we were doubling at the Cotton Club. We had an extra band to play till we got to the Cotton Club. We were the first band to play Maurice Chevalier at the Fulton Theatre. You know Maurice Chevalier. When he come to America, we played his debut at the Fulton Theatre on Broadway.
